simple.meaning: שָׂרַף (sâraph) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to be (causatively, set ) on fire.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 117 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 13 more, beginning at Genesis 11:3. Its contexts include family line, offering, Torah, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׂרַף (H8313).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שָׂרַף (sâraph) / H8313 is traced through Genesis 11:3, Genesis 38:24, Exodus 12:10, Exodus 29:14 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H8313. saraph שָׂרַף 117 verb burn (70 t. + בָּאֵשׁ , 2 t. + בְּמוֺאֵֿשׁ ) (Late Hebrew (rare) = Biblical Hebrew; Assyrian šarâpu; Aramaic שְׂרַף (rare); is absorb, consume ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳שׂ Josh 11:9 +, 3 feminine singular suffix שְׂרָפָ֫חַם Isa 47:14 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִשְׂרֹף Num 19:5 2 t., more often וַיִּשְׂרֹף Exod 32:20 +, 2 masculine plural תִּשְׂרְפוּן Deut 7:5 2 t.; Infinitive absolute שָׂרוֺף 2Sam 23:7 ; construct שְׂרֹף Jer 36:25 +; suffix שָׂרְפוֺ Judg 9:52 ; Amos 2:1 ; Participle active שׂרֵף Lev 16:28 ; Num 19:8 , plural שׂרְפִים 2Kin 17:31 ; passive masculine plural שְׂרֻפִים Num 17:4 ; feminine singular שְׂרוּפָה 1Sam 30:3 , שְׂרֻפָה Psa 80:17 , plural שְׂרוּפוֺת Neh 3:24 , construct שְׂרֻפוֺת Isa 1:7 ; — burn (59 t. + בָּאֵשׁ , 2 t. + בְּמוֺאֵֿשׁ ): 1 in making bricks , + לִשְׂרֵפָה Gen 11:3 (J; object omitted). 2. a. with accusative of thing, usually to destroy, e.g. door Judg 9:52 , house 12:1 ; 1Kin 16:18 (both with עַל person), Jer 39:8 11 t., compare passive participle Neh 3:24 , city Josh 6:24 ; 1Sam 30:1 , 14 16 t., compare passive participle 30:3 ; Isa 1:7 , chariots Josh 11:6 , 9 ; 2Kin 23:11 ; Psa 46:10 (subject ׳י ), idols, etc., Exod 32:20 (accusative omitted), Deut 9:21 10 t., roll Jer 36:25 , 27 , 28 , 29 , 32 , wood Isa 44:16 , 19 (both + בְּמוֺאֵֿשׁ ), compare Psa 80:17 (figurative), Jer 51:32 , hair Ezek 5:4 ; bones, to lime (as outrage) Amos 2:1 ; upon altars (in desecration) 1Kin 13:2 ; 1Ki 23:16; 1Ki 23:20 2Chr 34:5 ; bodies, as funeral rite 1Sam 31:12 (rare custom, RS Semitic i. 353; 2nd ed. 372 ; but Klo Bu read יִשְׂמְּדוּ [= ׳יִס ]; compare Benz Archaeology 163 ; Ency. Bib. DEAD Now Archaeology i. 188 ); ׳שׂ as funeral rite also (object omitted, probably spices, compare 2Chr 16:14 ), with ל person mort. Jer 34:5 , + accusative of congnate meaning with verb שְׂרֵפָה 2Chr 16:14 (compare שְׂרֵפָה ); in ceremonial of P (never of burning sacrifice on altar, הִקְטִיר , compare הֶעְֶלֶה , but) chiefly (14 t.) of consuming refuse, especially unused portions of victims, etc. (to prevent use), and infected objects, Exod 29:14 , 34 +, sometimes לַמַּחֲנֶה מִחוּץ Lev 4:12 (+ עַעֵָֿצִים ), 4:21 4:21 4 t., etc., compare Ezek 43:21 ; also of burning red heifer (to produce ashes for purification) Num 19:5 (twice in verse); 19:3 . b. burn , with accusative of person, (1) as penalty Josh 7:25 (JE), Judg 14:15 ; 15:6 ; Lev 20:14 , compare Num 17:4 (passive participle), so, אֵשׁ subject, Isa 47:14 , with accusative of congnate meaning with verb שְׂרֵפָה Lev 10:6 (P); (2) as sacrifice, Jer 7:31 ; 19:5 ; + ל dei Deut 12:31 ; 2Kin 17:31 . Niph`al Imperfect 3masculine singular יִשָּׂרֵף Josh 7:15 +, 3 feminine plural תִּשָּׂרַפְנָה Prov 6:27 , etc.; — be burned (11 t. + בָּאֵשׁ ): of city Jer 38:17 + 38:23 (read תִּשָּׂרֵף for ᵑ7 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 תִּשְׂרֹף Hi Ew Gf Gie Du), idols, etc., Micah 1:7 ; 1Chr 14:12 ; ritually (compare Qal 2 a near the end ) Lev 4:12 ; 6:23 ; 7:17 , 19 ; 13:52 ; 19:6 ; of person, as penalty Gen 38:24 (J), Josh 7:15 (JE), 2Sam 23:7 (poetry), Lev 21:9 (H).
